sources.title: [PATCH v4 2/2] media: i2c: imx678: Add driver for Sony IMX678

claims.claim: Add a V4L2 subdev driver for the Sony IMX678 image sensor. IMX678 is a diagonal 8.86 mm (Type 1/1.8) CMOS active pixel type solid-state image sensor with a square pixel array and 8.40 M effective pixels. claims.claim: GCC 16.1 has been released! Lots of good C++26 material including reflection and contracts. GCC 16 Release Series: Changes, New Features, and Fixes From the announcement: C++20 by default: [...]  N.B. C++20 modules support is still experimental and must be enabled by  -fmodules .
